children.game_version: Use a scarf to invite friends to dance in a circle.

seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and range of motion.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Uses a fan and a shawl.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Dancer moves from the side of the stage to the center; in some regions, it is performed in a circle.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: The dancer moves with hip thrusts.
movement_profile.partnering: The dancer throws a shawl to an audience member to invite them to dance.

signature_moves.description: The dancer throws her shawl to an audience member to bring him to the stage.
signature_moves.name: Shawl Invitation

music_profile.sound_description: A traditional ensemble similar to the gamelan, featuring violins, drums, and gongs.
music_profile.vocal_style: A singer is present to sing the accompanying song.

basic_steps: Start at the side of the stage.
Move to the center stage using hip thrusts.
Throw a shawl to an audience member to invite them to dance.
teaching.formation: The dancer begins at the side of the stage; in Lombok, it is performed in a circle.
